bundle.shortDescription: The window and tray of this machine's Tatolab runtime
bundle.longDescription: Tatolab shows the streams this machine's Tatolab runtime holds as they start and stop, each stream's graph and logs, and the Run Tatolab switch, from a window and the tray. On Linux it drives the systemd user service tatolabd.service that the Tatolab installer sets up (curl -fsSL https://get.tatolab.com/install.sh | sh); it installs no runtime itself.
